reading.summary: LDW200-55534-1 INSTL, section 1 of 2 (J-size roll): installation of the descent-stage base heat-shield blankets (-11 and -13 assemblies, taped with GT835BE-8) on the LM descent stage: SECTION A-A, a plan of the base (cut at this frame's right edge), SECTION B-B, SECT C-C (TYP OVERLAP) and the -13 ASSY (BASE BLANKET), not to scale
reading.description: An installation drawing, not a part drawing: it shows how the base blankets go on the descent stage, with the stage, its engine and gear drawn as reference. SECTION A-A (left, cut on the -Z axis at the A arrow under the view) is a section through the descent stage: the descent engine's nozzle (bell) on the centre line between the central beams and decks, the outrigger (landing gear) struts left and right with their pivots, and the blankets drawn as wavy double lines: the upper blanket over the stage's top (LDW280-17725-7, overlaps 6"-8" typ) and the base blanket wrapped round the lower deck and up the sides, called out GT835BE-8 (REF) (the tape) and -11 (REF). The plan (right; -Y at the top, +Y at the bottom, -Z to the left; the view runs off this section's right edge at the paper's cut, x ~10290, so its +Z half is on the next frame) shows the base blanket's panels: an octagonal base outline with 45-degree panels, hidden (dashed) blanket edges beneath, the tape strips (GT835BE-8 at 6-8' pitch, 2-3" long) drawn as small rectangles along the panel edges, fastener/stud positions as four-point crosses spaced 4 EQ SP and 2 EQ SP with 4", 6", 21", 11.5" and 27" dimensions, a section D-D cut (two D arrows) and the section C-C cut (the C at the cut edge), the -13 (REF) and LDW280-25508 (REF) callouts and a half circle at the +Y end. SECTION B-B (not to scale) shows the layup: the -11 balloon with (5 LAYERS ON -13) and FABRICATE PER LPC280-1. SECT C-C (TYP OVERLAP) shows two blanket edges overlapping 3"-4" with GT835BE-8 tape. -13 ASSY (BASE BLANKET) is a long rectangle 238"-242" by 35"-37" with the B-B cut and a GS577A-1 (REF) callout. Format: J roll, zones 5..2 across and C..A down, NAS 9-1100 aperture-card stamp and frame counter 01/02 (foreign).
